name: Breeze TTS (voice clone)
description: Speech in a cloned voice. Give it a clean reference clip and that clip's exact transcript, and it says whatever you write in the same voice. Tick "Direct the read" to keep the voice but steer the delivery.

params.label: Reference voice
params.description: A clean clip of the voice to copy. Ten to thirty seconds of ordinary speech does more than a minute of anything noisy.

params.label: Transcript
params.description: Exactly what the reference clip says, word for word. The model lines the two up, so a wrong transcript is heard as a worse clone.

params.label: Text
params.description: What you want it to say. (sigh), (laugh), (cough) and (clears throat) work inline; punctuation and line breaks are where it pauses.

params.label: Direct the read
params.description: Keep the cloned voice but steer tone, emotion and pace. Plain cloning takes no instruction: the reference is the delivery.

params.label: Direction
params.description: How to deliver the line, in words: "slowly, restrained, serious".
params.default: Speak slowly, with a restrained, serious tone.

params.label: Seed
params.description: Breeze TTS 2 takes a seed up to 2^31 - 1, and reads 0 as "use the current random state" — so a roll here lands between 1 and that.

params.label: Model build
params.description: The pack's loader picks a build by name and fetches it on first use; it is not a file from the model library.

params.label: Direction strength
params.description: How hard the instruction is pushed. Only the directed read uses it; plain cloning runs at 1.0, which is what "copy the reference" means.

params.label: Maximum length
params.description: Audio frames to generate at 12.5 per second; the model stops at the end of the text by itself.
